message: 甘いばかりが和菓子じゃない

name: Sally
message: 「Purr-meow~~\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「What's the matter?」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat swee~~ts\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. You just ate some a moment ago, didn't you?」

name: Sally
message: 「Just a little more! Just a little is fine! Just a tiny little bit is fine! Please! Pleaaase」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, you're so hopeless~」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, I loooove you, Ria\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「There, there\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「What an intense coaxing voice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's toootally being tamed with food」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm so jealous...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you want to eat sweets that badly? You're quite the glutton, Vice President~」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha!? N-No I'm not!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what is it」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that you want to be spoiled by Ria-senpai like Sally-chan is?」

name: Misa
message: 「So what if I'm a glutton!!」
And so, everyone eats the ankoro-mochi we received from Ria-senpai.

name: Sally
message: 「Mmmm~~. So delicious~~. I'm so happy I could cry~~」

name: Ria
message: 「You really do love sweets, don't you?」

name: Sally
message: 「I totally love them. Super love them. Love ya so much. Love, love, looove them」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, maybe I'll have you help out a little」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「With Student Council activities... you see\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehhh~~ No way~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Tut-tut. Don't be so selfish」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, go in my place~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I don't really mind」

name: Ria
message: 「I see, I see. Even though~~ Delicious--ah, never mind. Never mi~nd」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh!? Delicious what?」

name: Ria
message: 「What a shame~~ Even though delicious--oops, never mind」

name: Sally
message: 「Unfair, so unfair~! Fine~! I just have to help out, right~」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks♪」
She really is Helena-san's little sister, alright.

name: Sally
message: 「Alright, let's go, Prez」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sally
message: 「You said you didn't mind, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That was only if I was going in your place--」

name: Sally
message: 「It'll be over faster if we go together!! Come on, let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Have a good trip」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have business at Prier?」

name: Ria
message: 「This place is basically like our clubroom, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai's club is--」

name: Ria
message: 「The Wagashi Club♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohh~」
That's so like her, or whatever you'd call it.
Though apparently, she's supposed to have resigned on paper when she became Student Council President.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, hello~」
It's Misasagi-senpai, Ria-senpai's friend.

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan is the president of the Wagashi Club」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「The Wagashi Club, was it」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep, yep」
Though it seems she nominally stepped down when I became Student Council President.

name: Synn
message: 「Which means--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~」

name: Ria
message: 「So, about helping out today--」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey! What's this delicious food!? Hurry up and tell me~~!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just like Ria said, what a lively little thing」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm Sally-chan! Vanguard captain of the Delicious Food Squad!!」

name: Ria
message: 「See? A perfect fit, right?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hehe. Truly, she is」

name: Synn
message: 「What's this all about?」

name: Ria
message: 「For the upcoming Kirakira Festival, we were thinking of setting up a stall for the Wagashi Club too」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh--」

name: Ria
message: 「And so, we're planning to unveil a new creation we co-developed with the chef at Prier」

name: Sally
message: 「A new creation?」

name: Ria
message: 「A brand-new wagashi\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「So THAT'S the delicious food!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Which is why I invited you all to a tasting session today」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, is that all~ If you'd just said so from the start, I'd have helped out as much as you wanted--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. What a mercenary little kid you are」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, Prez. You can go home now」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What~~!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Otherwise there'll be less food for me to eat, right?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's plenty to go around, so don't worry about it」

name: Ria
message: 「Though, since it's an experimental dish, I can't guarantee it'll taste good...」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. If it's something you came up with, Ria-senpai, it's bound to be delicious!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah. 'Cause Ria's got huge boobs」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that has anything to do with it\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Akane-chan!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Your juniors sure adore you. I'm so jealous」

name: Ria
message: 「T-That's not true~~ geez! Come on, time to get ready」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yeah, yeah」
I end up waiting alone with Sally-chan.

name: Sally
message: 「What's gonna come out? What's gonna come out?」

name: Synn
message: 「My heart's pounding」

name: Sally
message: 「You know, Ria really does have the biggest boobs」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What kind of topic is that all of a sudden?」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna hurry up and get bigger than Ria too~」

name: Sally
message: 「And then! I'll charm the whole world and get tons of yummy food as presents!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uh-huh」

name: Sally
message: 「That ticks me off so much!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So Sally-chan is a girl too, huh. Alright! Then let's drink lots of milk and make your chest bigger!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, let's aim for a killer bod!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「What were you talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just a conversation full of dreams」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that so? Tell me about it later too, okay?♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's not somethin' you need to worry about, Ria-chan」

name: Sally
message: 「Snacks, snacks! Hurry, hurry!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, yes. Don't be in such a rush」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa!! That looks delicious!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this... castella?」

name: Ria
message: 「Miso matsukaze~♪ It's kind of like a Japanese-style castella, I guess」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh-ho~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's freshly made, so it's nice and rich and ever so delicious」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey!! Can I eat it!? I can eat it, right!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Help yourself to plenty, now. Here, for you too, Mr. Panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, don't mind if I do」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't hold back either, Synn-kun. Say ahh」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, say ahh♪」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Ria really is just adorable」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh-- Why are you laughing, Akane-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Look how flustered the President is getting」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-I'm not getting--embarrassed or anything, okay」

name: Ria
message: 「C-Could it be I was bothering you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, not at all! I'll eat it, I'll eat it! Ahh. Nom」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I'm glad\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「No fair, Lord Synn! Ria-chan, say 'ahh' and feed the great me too--!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you go, say ahh~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't want it~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, what a mean thing to say. Don't hold back now, go on and eat up」

name: Paqy
message: 「Maybe once your boobs get a little bigger!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「How about you knock off the messing around already?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-Yes ma'am--! I humbly accept--!」

name: Sally
message: 「M~~m, it's so good~~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here. Have seconds」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!!」

name: Synn
message: 「--Wait, sorry for giving such useless feedback even though you went through the trouble of letting me taste-test...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I don't mind at all. Honestly, having you express everything so straightforwardly like that makes me much happier」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Oh, have some tea too」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much. *Sip...* Whew」

name: Sally
message: 「How should I put it... It's a deliciousness that words just can't describe!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「A moist, chewy softness. Truly an elegant flavor that evokes the ancient capital」

name: Synn
message: 「You're quite the gourmet for a plushie, aren't you」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, it still doesn't come close to us, the Delicious Food Squad, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for the meal~」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks~~ It was su--per delicious♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Everything you come up with is always so well-received, Ria. Just as expected.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like they say, we do best at the things we love.」

name: Sally
message: 「Aah~~. I wish we had delicious stuff like this in the Demon World too~」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you have wagashi in the Demon World?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nobody makes anything this good, and I don't think anyone even wants to make it in the first place.」

name: Sally
message: 「Even when it comes to cooking meals, they hate it 'cause it's too much of a hassle.」

name: Sally
message: 「There's nothing in the Demon World. It's totally empty. Super boring.」

name: Sally
message: 「That's why I come to the Human World to hang out like this!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see~. Then why don't you try asking the Demon Lord or someone for wagashi?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, the Demon Lord--」

name: Synn
message: 「Pffft! *Cough*!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You shouldn't eat so fast.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, you're such a little kid despite how you look, Ria.」

name: Sally
message: 「\{In the Demon World|\s12\s12\s12}, you see, there is no Demon Lord.」

name: Sally
message: 「If there were a Demon Lord, we wouldn't be able to do whatever we want.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「When people speak of the Demon Lord, doesn't he have loads of underlings and go around destroying the world?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ha, hahaha... Destroying the world? There's no way he'd do something like--」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahaha! Even if there were a Demon Lord, nobody would listen to him anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... So there's... no Demon Lord.」
Even I, the guy himself, thought it sounded like a fairy tale, yet does Senpai actually believe the Demon Lord exists?
Still, there's no way I can just say "I'm right here!" in this situation.
Still, I wonder why. Ria-senpai looks kind of lonely.
Most of them are probably planning to destroy the world like Misasagi-senpai said, so I'd think it's better if they aren't around, though...
D-Don't tell me... they're the sworn enemies of the Kujou family for generations or something?! Yikes!!

name: Sally
message: 「Huh?! Found 'em, Japanese sweets!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm?」
Sally-chan is spreading open a catalog with a somewhat ominous color.

name: Sally
message: 「I didn't think they'd have any, but... look, Demon World Mail-Order actually has Japanese sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~. So that's the Demon World Mail-Order catalog.」

name: Sally
message: 「What a surprise, what a surprise. So there are Demons who make them too.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If they're just doin' whatever they please, makin' Japanese sweets is fine too, isn't it?」

name: Sally
message: 「I see~. Makes sense.」
Demons who make Japanese sweets, huh...
No way could either of those two be a Demon--.

name: Sally
message: 「Alright, decided. Time to order, time to order!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hello? It's me, Sally-chan. I'll trade my motorized slippers for these Japanese sweets.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ta-da! Japanese sweet treats!」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast! How convenient is that...」

name: Sally
message: 「Here, Ria. Thanks for giving me those sweets earlier.」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you sure?」
Sweets wrapped individually in plastic.
Written clearly in hiragana, they say "senbei."

name: Sally
message: 「Some for you too, big sis over there.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged.」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll give some to you too, Prez.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh? I didn't do anything, though?」

name: Sally
message: 「You gave me milk earlier, didn't you?」
Sally-chan is selfish and blunt, yet she never forgets a favor, huh.

name: Sally
message: 「You're thinking something rude, aren't you!! Forget it, I'm not giving you any」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Here, dig in before they get cold!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oka~y」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wonder what kind of rice crackers these are」
There was a crisp, lively crunch.

name: Sally
message: 「How are they? Good?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「They're wasabi crackers. Quite delicious. Though--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria?」

name: Ria
message: 「Delicious! So delicious! A little wasabi... ngh, I can handle a little wasabi\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Your eyes are watering like crazy, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「They're tears of joy from how good it is」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? I'm glad\s07 Here, you can have the Prez's share too」

name: Ria
message: 「Auuh~~\s06」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, how endearing~」
Ria-senpai sure has it rough, having all sorts of appearances to keep up.
